question: Who among the following won the Arjuna Award 2021 in Para Archery?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Harvinder Singh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Harvinder Singh won the Arjuna award in 2021 in the Para Archery discipline.

Arjuna Award__:

 
• ​Arjuna Award for outstanding performance in Sports and Games is given for good performance over a period of the** previous four years** and for showing **qualities of leadership, sportsmanship, and a sense of discipline.**
 
• ​The Arjuna award is the **highest sporting honor in India.**
